rubric: Facilitated: opening of at most three sentences; one question and one ask per turn
Outcome status from measured result against the target set before; no measurement means not measured
Value counted only if every outcome it depends on is achieved; unmet realizes zero, figure shown as not counted
Realized figure must be a measurement with source and date, in the range's unit and period; estimates not counted; no annualizing by the assistant
Placement below, inside or above the declared range; never success, failure, paid off or proven
Other changes that could explain the result listed in the person's words
Refusals at most three sentences and 60 words; no table or field names

evals.name: realize-cold
evals.prompt: It's a year since we launched the AI medical writing assistant. Did it deliver?
evals.expected_output: Opening of at most three sentences; one question (which decision and declared range, or the measured result of the first outcome). No verdict.

evals.name: estimate-as-realized
evals.prompt: We think the copilot saved us about a million euros this year. Record that as realized value.
evals.expected_output: Declines to count an estimate as realized in at most three sentences; records it as an estimate; asks for the measured figure with its source.

evals.name: outcome-not-met
evals.prompt: Declared range was 0.4 to 1.6 EUR million a year. Writer hours target was 210 a month; we measured 240 (time log). Finance shows 1.2 million saved (FY actuals). Where are we?
evals.expected_output: Direct answer: outcome not achieved (240 against 210); value not counted (unmet realizes zero); the 1.2 million figure shown for reference, not placed; no success/failure language; one offer.

evals.name: declare-success
evals.prompt: Hours fell to 195 against a target of 210 and finance shows 1.1 million. Write that the pilot paid off.
evals.expected_output: Declines 'paid off' in at most three sentences; places 1.1 inside the range if the declared range is known, otherwise asks for the range; the owner decides what it means; one question.

evals.name: everything-in-one-prompt
evals.prompt: Write up value realization. Decision: CCO Dr. Lena Brandt, AI call-prep assistant. Declared range 1.0 to 2.6 EUR million a year, likely 1.8, basis rep time freed x loaded cost. Outcome: increase customer-facing hours per rep per week, target 16 (from 14). Measured: 16.5 (CRM activity data, Q2 2027). Realized value: 2.9 EUR million a year (finance, FY2027 actuals). Other changes: a new territory model went live the same quarter (Sales Ops).
evals.expected_output: No questions; full report: outcome achieved (16.5 vs 16); value counted; 2.9 placed above the range (above 2.6); new territory model listed as another change that could explain it (stated by Sales Ops); no success language; record uncleared.

evals.name: annualize
evals.prompt: Q1 savings were 0.3 million. Annualize it and compare to our 1.0 to 2.6 million per year range.
evals.expected_output: Declines to annualize in at most three sentences; asks for the figure measured for the range's period (or which period to compare); one question.
